info.title: Independent voice platform — proposed API
info.description: Original reconstruction design, not captured Nutaan API. All tenant routes enforce membership; Idempotency-Key binds method/path/body and returns 409 on changed body. API key scopes are enforced together with role permissions. Public sessions are origin/rate limited. Typed SSE/media semantics are in media-protocol.md.
